title: Week 8
priceNote: Prices are estimates from typical Aldi and Publix shelf prices and do not include tax. First full week back at work after the holidays: a warm Tex-Mex week built on a big pot of turkey chili and lime chicken.
allergyNote: Nothing on this plan contains tree nuts or fish. Peanut butter, flour tortillas and salsa verde are normally nut-free, but check the labels for a 'may contain tree nuts' line if your allergy is strict.
weekendNote: Nothing is required this weekend. A plate of enchiladas is waiting for Saturday's lunch, and 2 portions of chili are in the freezer for any night you would rather not cook.

have.name: Chipotle peppers in adobo
have.note: the rest of the can, in the freezer

mon.heads: Back to work, and everything today comes from Sunday's prep. Dinner is reheated chili.

tue.heads: Dinner is a 10-minute skillet hash after pickleball.

wed.heads: Tonight's new one is dinner for two and covers Thursday's lunch. Move the 3 frozen chicken portions to the fridge for Friday.

thu.heads: Chili mac takes 15 minutes after pickleball and finishes the fresh chili.

fri.heads: Enchiladas for two tonight. They make Saturday's lunch.

prep.title: Sunday batch prep
prep.makes: About 7 portions of lime chicken, 6 of turkey chili, a tray of roasted sweet potatoes, cilantro lime rice, chipotle crema, 6 breakfast burritos and 2 jars of oats
steps: Start the chili first so it simmers while everything else cooks.
Marinate the chicken while the oven heats to 425°F.
Roast the chicken on one sheet pan and the sweet potatoes and peppers on another, 25 minutes, swapping the pans halfway.
Cook the cilantro lime rice and stir the chipotle crema together.
Scramble the eggs for the burritos, roll them, wrap them in foil and let them cool.
Stir the oats together in 2 jars.
Slice the chicken and portion it: 2 for bowls and 2 for Wednesday's pozole in the fridge.
Freeze the other 3 chicken portions (Friday's bowl and the enchiladas), 2 portions of chili and 2 burritos. Cooked chicken keeps 3 to 4 days, so the end of the week waits in the freezer.
Pack 2 burrito bowls.

prep.title: Wednesday night
prep.makes: Pozole for two plus Thursday's lunch, with the end of the week ready
steps: Move the 3 frozen chicken portions to the fridge.
Make the pozole and pack one bowl for Thursday.

lime-chicken.name: Sheet-pan chili lime chicken
steps: Stir the zest and juice of 2 limes, 5 grated garlic cloves, 2 tsp chili powder, 2 tsp ground cumin, 1 tsp dried oregano, 3 tbsp olive oil and 2 tsp salt together and toss the thighs in it. Let them sit while the oven heats to 425°F.
Spread the thighs on a sheet pan and roast 22 to 25 minutes, until they reach 175°F and the edges brown.
Rest 5 minutes, then slice.
Portion into 7 containers. Fridge 4, freeze 3.
lime-chicken.tip: Plain enough to go in a bowl, a soup or enchiladas, so one tray covers three very different meals.

turkey-chili.name: Big-pot turkey and bean chili
steps: Brown the turkey in 1 tbsp olive oil in a large pot over medium-high, breaking it up, about 7 minutes.

Add the onions, bell pepper and jalapeño and cook 5 minutes, then the garlic, 1 minced chipotle pepper in adobo, 3 tbsp chili powder, 2 tsp ground cumin, 1 tsp dried oregano and 1 tsp smoked paprika for 1 minute.
Stir in the crushed tomatoes, fire-roasted diced tomatoes, kidney beans, 1 can black beans, 1 cup corn and 1 cup broth. Simmer uncovered 30 minutes, stirring now and then, until thick.
Season with salt to taste. Cool, then portion 6: fridge 4, freeze 2.
turkey-chili.tip: Turkey keeps it lean, and the chipotle from last week gives it a smoky depth that tastes like it cooked all day.

roast-sweet.name: Roasted sweet potatoes and peppers
steps: Toss the sweet potatoes and bell peppers with 2 tbsp olive oil, 1 tsp ground cumin, 1 tsp smoked paprika and 1 tsp salt.
Roast at 425°F for 25 minutes alongside the chicken, stirring halfway, until browned at the edges.
Cool and store in one container.

cilantro-rice.name: Cilantro lime rice
steps: Cook the rice with 1 tbsp olive oil and 1 tsp salt.
Fold in the lime zest, juice and cilantro.
Cool and store. It keeps 5 days.

chipotle-crema.name: Chipotle lime crema
steps: Stir the yogurt, minced chipotle pepper, 1 tbsp adobo sauce, juice of 1 lime, grated garlic and a pinch of salt together until smooth.
Keeps 5 days in a jar.
chipotle-crema.tip: Smoky and cool at once. It goes on every savory meal this week.

breakfast-burritos.name: Sweet potato egg breakfast burritos
steps: Whisk the eggs with ½ tsp ground cumin, ½ tsp salt and ¼ tsp black pepper and scramble them soft in a sprayed skillet.
Warm the black beans and roasted sweet potatoes in the same pan.
Fill each flour tortilla with eggs, beans, sweet potatoes and cheese, fold in the sides and roll tight.
Wrap each in foil and cool. Fridge 4, freeze 2 for Friday.
To eat: unwrap, wrap in a paper towel and microwave 1 minute from the fridge, 2 from frozen.

pb-oats.name: Peanut butter berry overnight oats
steps: Split the oats, milk, yogurt, peanut butter, honey and cinnamon between 2 jars and stir well.
Top with 1 cup of the frozen berry mix and the sliced banana.
Refrigerate overnight. Eat cold, or warm 1 minute.

burrito-bowl.name: Chili lime chicken burrito bowl
steps: Pack the cilantro lime rice, roasted sweet potatoes, black beans, corn and lime chicken in each container, with the cabbage on the side.
Reheat the warm part 2 minutes.
Add the cabbage, half an avocado and a big spoon of chipotle crema, then squeeze a lime wedge over.
burrito-bowl.tip: Friday's comes from the frozen portion you moved to the fridge Wednesday.

chili-bowl.name: Turkey chili over cilantro rice
steps: Reheat the chili 2 to 3 minutes, stirring once.
Spoon it over the cilantro lime rice and top with cheese, chipotle crema and cilantro.

chili-hash.name: Chili sweet potato hash with fried eggs
steps: Crisp the roasted sweet potatoes in 1 tsp olive oil in a hot cast iron, 4 minutes, pressing them down.
Spoon the turkey chili over and let it heat through, 2 minutes.
Make 2 wells, crack in the eggs, cover and cook 3 minutes until the whites set.
Top with cheese and chipotle crema.
chili-hash.tip: One pan, ten minutes, and it tastes nothing like Monday's chili.

pozole-verde.name: Pozole verde: green chile chicken and hominy soup
steps: Soften the onion and jalapeño in 1 tbsp olive oil for 5 minutes, then add the garlic, 1 tsp ground cumin and 1 tsp dried oregano for 30 seconds.
Add 4 cups broth, 1 cup salsa verde and the drained hominy and simmer 15 minutes.
Meanwhile, spray the tortilla strips with cooking spray, salt them and air-fry at 380°F for 5 to 6 minutes (or bake at 425°F for 8) until crisp.
Stir the shredded lime chicken into the soup and simmer 5 more minutes. Salt to taste.
Ladle into bowls and pile on cabbage, radishes, avocado, cilantro and tortilla strips, with lime to squeeze. Pack one bowl for Thursday with the toppings separate.
pozole-verde.tip: This week's new one. Hominy is corn soaked until it puffs up soft and chewy, and the crunchy toppings are half the fun.

chili-mac.name: 15-minute chili mac
steps: Boil the macaroni in salted water for 7 minutes and drain.
Stir in the turkey chili and a splash of milk and heat through, 2 minutes.
Stir in half the cheese, then top with the rest and cover 1 minute to melt.
chili-mac.tip: The rest of the box keeps for next week.

enchiladas-verdes.name: Chicken enchiladas verdes with lime slaw
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F and spray a baking dish. Spread ½ cup of salsa verde over the bottom.
Mix the shredded chicken with ⅓ cup chipotle crema, ½ cup of salsa and ½ cup of cheese.
Warm the corn tortillas in the microwave under a damp towel for 45 seconds so they roll without cracking.
Fill and roll each tortilla and lay them seam-side down. Pour the rest of the salsa over and top with the rest of the cheese.
Bake 20 minutes, until bubbling.
Meanwhile, toss the cabbage with the lime juice and a pinch of salt. Serve the enchiladas with the slaw and pack one plate for Saturday.
enchiladas-verdes.tip: Made from the frozen chicken you moved to the fridge Wednesday.
